name: Roll A Ball (Modified)
author: CapitalKage
description: This is my Roll A Ball build from the Unity Tutorial. I have modified the game slightly to show my own personal tweaks to the game. In my version, you have player health which can be deducted by running into enemies. I have also increased the speed of the ball movement to make it more challenging to avoid the enemies. You will also find ramps and multi-tier ramps to give the level more exploration and a deeper challenge. Finally, I have added a game over message that will appear if you have lost all your health points.
